**Pre-release (beta) — test it on your own servers; not yet production-certified.**

## Unth Recover v0.3.0-beta — offsite copies (cloud storage + Google Drive), Coolify/Dokploy, .rpm, Compose

Everything from v0.2.0-alpha (backups proven by a real isolated restore; a backup is `VERIFIED`
only after every mandatory check passed) plus:

### New
- **Offsite copies** (`offsite:`) — every VERIFIED backup is also copied off the server:
  - **S3-compatible storage**: AWS S3, **Google Cloud Storage**, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, Hetzner, MinIO, …
  - **cloud drives via rclone**: **Google Drive**, OneDrive, Dropbox, SFTP, WebDAV, … (rclone is included in the container image)
  - encrypted with **age** while streaming (artifact *and* manifest), `copy.json` **Ed25519-signed**
  - every copy is **downloaded again and proven** (signature, hashes, decryption) before anything is pruned → `REMOTE_VERIFIED`; failure → exit code 5, nothing pruned
  - offsite retention, `unth offsite list|check|push|prune`
  - **disaster recovery**: `unth offsite fetch` on a new machine, then `unth verify` restores it
- **`unth keys generate`** — encryption identity + signing key (never overwritten); offline recovery recipients
- **Coolify, Dokploy, Docker Compose**: `unth discover jobs` finds their PostgreSQL databases and writes ready-to-review jobs (same image for the restore test; passwords are never read)
- **Packages**: `.rpm` (Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, AlmaLinux) and a **`compose.yaml`** (scheduler + panel) pinned to this release
- **`unth schedule --at 03:00`** — built-in scheduler for containers
- **Panel**: offsite copies on the overview and per backup; `--behind-proxy` for Coolify/Dokploy/Traefik
- Metadata schema v2 (automatic upgrade)

### Tested
CI: PostgreSQL 12–17 integration matrix; offsite end to end against an S3 server (SeaweedFS)
including fetch on an empty machine + isolated restore → VERIFIED, tampered copies and wrong
credentials rejected; rclone backend through the real binary; Compose deployment; Coolify-style
discovery → generated job VERIFIED in the container; `.deb` (Debian) and `.rpm` (Rocky 9, Fedora 41)
install tests; govulncheck, gosec, gitleaks. Clean-machine test of the published release.
Not yet tested by the project against real Google Cloud Storage, AWS or Google Drive accounts.
Details: docs/TEST_RESULTS.md.

### Known limitations
- Linux only; the local data directory is not encrypted (offsite copies are)
- Single admin token for the panel (no roles yet)
- Restoring into your production database is manual (`pg_restore`); roles/privileges are not verified
- Docker socket access is root-equivalent

### Install
```bash
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unmadethings/unthrecover/main/scripts/install.sh
sudo sh install.sh --version v0.3.0-beta
```
Or: `sudo apt install ./unthrecover_0.3.0-beta_amd64.deb` · `sudo dnf install ./unthrecover_0.3.0-beta_amd64.rpm` ·
download `compose.yaml` and `docker compose up -d` · `docker pull ghcr.io/unmadethings/unthrecover:v0.3.0-beta`

Offsite setup (Google Cloud Storage, S3, Google Drive): docs/OFFSITE.md · Coolify/Dokploy: docs/COOLIFY_DOKPLOY.md
